# Release Management

This layer of docturnal is responsible for managing archive hashes, model digests, and checksums for Ollama releases.

## Overview

Manages archive hashes, records model digests, and computes checksums for Ollama releases.

## Responsibilities

- Manages archive hashes
- Records model digests
- Computes checksums

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`scripts/archive-hashes.js`](../scripts/archive-hashes.js) | Lists archive hashes and files. | `hashArchive`, `hashTar`, `wanted`, `field` |
| [`scripts/update-models.js`](../scripts/update-models.js) | Records model digests. | `fetchPin`, `manifestUrl`, `pinFromManifest`, `main` |
| [`scripts/update-ollama.sh`](../scripts/update-ollama.sh) | Computes checksums and writes digests. |  |

## How it works

- `scripts/archive-hashes.js`: This script lists archive hashes and files. It defines functions like `hashArchive`, `hashTar`, `wanted`, and `field` to handle the hashing of archives and files.
- `scripts/update-models.js`: This script records model digests. It defines functions like `fetchPin`, `manifestUrl`, `pinFromManifest`, and `main` to fetch and record model digests from a manifest URL.

## Configuration

- Configuration files: `pins/models.json`.
